name: CapsBench
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate detailed image captioning performance, supporting assessment of text-to-image models on prompt adherence, complex reasoning, and accurate text rendering.
reputation: A specialized captioning benchmark that is useful for detailed prompt adherence and text rendering evaluation, but it is not yet broadly adopted as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Introduced alongside Playground v3 model; supports evaluation of detailed captions with varying levels of detail and diverse text structures.
